test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Ishita will playing Tennis for her favourite team.
solution:
The correct answer is: **will playing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the phrase 'will playing' is incorrect.
 
• The phrase "will playing" is incorrect because **"will" **should be followed by the **base form of the verb**, which is **"play."**
 
• The correct phrase is **"will play,"** indicating** future tense**.
 
• Hence, **'will play'** must replace** 'will playing'** to make the sentence grammatically correct.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *Ishita will play Tennis for her favourite team*.
